definitions.gloss: within range; within the sphere; inside the area
definitions.explanation: Inside a defined boundary or zone, whether physical (signal range, commuting distance) or abstract (sphere of influence). Often used with a preceding noun to specify what kind of range.

examples.japanese: ここは{通勤|つうきん}{圏内|けんない}だ。
examples.english: This area is within commuting distance.

examples.japanese: スマホの{電波|でんぱ}が{圏内|けんない}に{戻|もど}った。
examples.english: The phone signal came back into range.

examples.japanese: {首都|しゅと}{圏内|けんない}の{人口|じんこう}は{年々|ねんねん}{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: The population within the capital region is increasing year by year.

notes:
USAGE:
{圏内|けんない} is typically used with a preceding noun that specifies the type of range or zone: {通勤|つうきん}{圏内|けんない} (commuting range), {首都|しゅと}{圏内|けんない} (within the capital region), etc. It is also commonly used for mobile phone signal coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通勤|つうきん}{圏内|けんない} (within commuting distance)
- {首都|しゅと}{圏内|けんない} (within the greater capital area)
- {圏内|けんない}に{入|はい}る (to come within range)
- {射程|しゃてい}{圏内|けんない} (within firing range)
- {勢力|せいりょく}{圏内|けんない} (within a sphere of influence)

CONTRAST:
{圏外|けんがい} is the antonym, meaning outside the range or out of coverage. On mobile phones, {圏外|けんがい} is the indicator shown when there is no signal.
